title: 第21章 借钱
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “钱不在我这，你爸昨天就拿出去了。”范金花没气头上的徐喜弟犟，只好如实告知。“那，我爸呢，今天去哪儿了？”徐喜弟在屋里找了一圈，都没找到人。来到张永福的屋，还没进门，就被一股味冲出来。“人呢？去哪儿了？”“我哪里知道，他昨天去了隔壁村，定了一头牛仔，下个月咱家就能有一头小牛仔了。”范金花如实交代。徐喜弟扶了扶额，拿去买牛崽子了？不对，养牛！“买牛崽子，以后谁割草？是爸去，还是你去？”张家这是明显给她安排的活！范金花口中喃喃，具体说什么她也没听清。“不行，先把钱要回来！买牛的事，今年的猪卖了，再去买。”徐喜弟立马就否决了张家用这钱去买牛的事。“赵丁这事，不能这么了！”正好，张国海从门外进来，弓着腰，手还非得背在后面，“钱都给人家了，怎么要？我可没这个脸！”他红着脸，也不知道在哪里喝酒回来的。徐喜弟看着老两口，心里很失望。说她年纪小，不让她插手赵丁的事，结果他们就是这样解决问题的。一家子懦弱到了这个程度。“没脸去要回来这个钱，全村人都在背后戳着我们脊梁骨，就有脸了？”张国海摆摆手，一副死猪样，“你不怕丢人，你去要。”“我去就我去，你给谁家了？”张国海不说，背着手进屋睡觉去了。徐喜弟看看范金花，等她说。可是范金花只是瞪了瞪眼，“我哪里知道给谁家了，我又没一起去。”两口子，这是打算就这么放任赵丁和李二拐的事了。“行，你们都当缩头乌龟，那我来！”徐喜弟空着手，就冲出门。她直接就去了刘德怀家。这村子，刘宇宁和刘烨，就是她唯一能找的人。可是傻叔一穷二白的，除了一身力气，啥都没有。刘德怀一家人在火房，围着灶吃午饭。“宇宁哥，你在家吗？”徐喜弟也没敢进屋，就在院子里，伸长脖子叫人。不到一分钟，刘宇宁就从屋里出来。“怎么了，喜弟。”“宁宇哥，你身上有钱吗？能不能借我五十块？”徐喜弟一点都不扭捏，开门见山，张口就借钱。刘宇宁一愣，很快表情就变成了担心，“出什么事了吗？”“赵丁的事，他给了家里五十块钱私了，我爸拿钱去买牛了。”徐喜弟也不隐瞒，她对刘宇宁，什么话都是毫无保留的。“可是你今天也听见了，村里人把我们家说成卖皮的，这事我咽不下。”“明明巴儿姐啥也不懂，一块糖就给人骗去脱了衣服，他们就是臭流氓，恶徒！绝对不能这么简单放过他们。”早知道前几天，就该直接绑着送公安！“啥？收了赵丁五十块钱私了？”刘宇宁也瞪大了双眼。“这不是胡闹吗？”他二话不说，转身就进屋。王秀菊已经端着饭碗，站在火房的门口，院里的对话，也听得一清二楚。她还没说话，自己儿子就问钱了。“妈，借我五十块，等上班，我第一个月发了工资就还你。”“这个钱不能借！”王秀菊脱口就拒绝。“妈~这事不是开玩笑的，快去拿钱！”刘宇宁脸色都变了。今天要是不拿这五十块，他这辈子都没脸见徐喜弟。王秀菊看他黑着脸，也不敢说更多拒绝的话，只好乖乖放下碗，去屋里拿钱。把钱交到刘宇宁手上，但是心里还是有些疼的，于是忍不住喃了一句。“说借，什么时候还？还得起吗？拿什么还。”“我说了，上班发了工资就还。”刘宇宁接过钱，转身就往门外走。“我又不是说你！”徐喜弟站在门外，堂屋里的话都听得见。为了让王秀菊放心，她扯着嗓子说，“婶，我养猪还。您要不放心，我可以写个条子，有条在，不怕赖账。”王秀菊撇了撇嘴。“条子？你认识几个字，就说写条子……”“写什么条，不用写。哥记在脑子里就行了。”刘宇宁把钱交给徐喜弟。“还是写条吧，钱还清就撕条，有凭有据。”徐喜弟虽然没读过书，但是这些基本的道理，她还是懂的。王秀菊不想借钱，无非怕她赖账。写个条子，是给王秀菊的。“真不用。”刘宇宁不觉得五十块对他来说，算多大的钱。别说五十了，只要她想要，五百，五千，他将来都想挣给她。“要的，必须要的。”徐喜弟坚持。“儿子，人家非要写，咱们推辞反而是咱们不对了。就让她写吧。”王秀菊可一点都不客气，转身就去刘宇宁房里，翻出纸笔。刘宇宁无奈地瞪着他老母亲，可是她当看不见，拿出来就塞徐喜弟手上。徐喜弟拿起圆珠笔，按出笔头，然后蹲下来，摊开作业本，放在膝盖上。可是想了好一会儿，都没下笔，抬起头，茫然地问，“哥，条子应该怎么写？”“不识字，还装文化人那套……”王秀菊哼了一声，抱着手在旁边看热闹。刘宇宁把人扶起来，拿过纸和笔，“我来写，你签名就行，会写名字吗？不会的话，你在下面打个勾也可以。”“还能这样？打勾就行吗？”徐喜弟大开眼界，这还是头一回听说。“嗯，不会写字的人，都这样。”刘宇宁点点头，然后刷刷写了一行字。“来，你在底下打个勾。”“好。”徐喜弟接过纸笔，在刘宇宁指定的位置下，小心翼翼又郑重地划了一个勾。可是划完之后，她反复看了又看，疑惑地问道，“哥，这一行字，哪个是五字？哪个是十字？别的字我不敢说，五字和十字，我是认识的。”“呃~”刘宇宁耳根子瞬间就热了热，很快就一本正经指着其中两个字，“是这两个，五十，正规的条子都这么写。”徐喜弟这才放心了，“原来写条子，五十这么写的。”她看了一眼，在心里默默记住。等徐喜弟拿着钱走人，刘宇宁快速撕下那一张‘借条’。只见上面一行字这样写道：刘宇宁喜欢徐喜弟，请批准。下面是徐喜弟打的勾。
content_en: "I don't have the money, your dad took it out yesterday." Fan Jinhua lost his temper and Xu Xidijiang had no choice but to tell the truth."Well, where is my dad? Where did he go today?" Xu Xidi searched around the house but couldn't find anyone.When I arrived at Zhang Yongfu's house, I was rushed out by a smell before I even entered the door."Where's the man? Where did he go?" "How did I know that he went to the next village yesterday and ordered a cowboy? Our family will have a little cowboy next month." Fan Jinhua told the truth.Xu Xidi raised his forehead and used it to buy cows?No, raising cattle!"Who will cut the grass after buying cows? Dad or you?" This was obviously a job arranged for her by the Zhang family!Fan Jinhua murmured in her mouth, but she couldn't hear exactly what she said."No, get the money back first! As for buying cows, buy this year's pigs after they are sold." Xu Xidi immediately vetoed the Zhang family's use of the money to buy cows."Zhao Ding, this matter can't be like this!" Just then, Zhang Guohai came in from the door, hunched over and holding his hands behind his back, "I've given the money to others, why do you want it? I don't have the face!" He blushed and didn't know where he came back from drinking.Xu Xidi looked at the old couple and felt very disappointed.They said she was young and didn't let her get involved in Zhao Ding's affairs, and that's how they solved the problem.The whole family is so cowardly."You don't have the shame to ask for this money back. The whole village is poking our backs in the back, so you have the shame?" Zhang Guohai waved his hands, looking like a dead pig, "You are not afraid of embarrassment, just go and ask for it." "I'll go, I'll go, who will you give it to?" Zhang Guohai didn't say anything, and went into the house to sleep with his hands behind his back.Xu Xidi looked at Fan Jinhua and waited for her to say.But Fan Jinhua just stared, "How could I know whose house it was given to, and I didn't go with it." The couple planned to just let Zhao Ding and Li Erguai go."Okay, you all are just cowering, then I'll do it!" Xu Xidi rushed out the door with his hands empty.She went directly to Liu Dehuai's house.In this village, Liu Yuning and Liu Ye were the only people she could find.But Uncle Silly was very poor and had nothing but strength.Liu Dehuai's family was in the fire room, having lunch around the stove."Brother Yuning, are you at home?" Xu Xidi didn't dare to enter the house. He just stood in the yard, craning his neck to call people.In less than a minute, Liu Yuning came out of the room."What's the matter, Xidi." "Brother Ning Yu, do you have any money? Can you lend me fifty yuan?" Xu Xidi was not shy at all, he went straight to the point and started borrowing money.Liu Yuning was stunned for a moment, and soon his expression turned into worry, "What happened?" "About Zhao Ding, he gave fifty yuan to the family for personal use, and my father used the money to buy cattle." Xu Xidi did not hide anything, she said nothing to Liu Yuning without reservation."But you heard it today. People in the village described our family as selling skins. I can't swallow this." "Sister Ba'er obviously doesn't understand anything, but she tricked people into taking off their clothes with a piece of candy. They are stinky hooligans and villains! We must not let them go so easily." If I had known a few days ago, I should have been tied up and sent to the police!"What? Did you take fifty yuan from Zhao Ding and keep it private?" Liu Yuning also widened his eyes."Isn't this nonsense?" Without saying a word, he turned around and entered the house.Wang Xiuju was already holding her rice bowl and standing at the door of the fire room, and she could hear clearly the conversation in the courtyard.Before she could say anything, her son asked for money."Mom, lend me fifty yuan. When I get to work, I will pay you back after my first month's salary." "You can't borrow this money!" Wang Xiuju blurted out and refused."Mom~ This is no joke, go and get the money!" Liu Yuning's face changed.If he didn't take the fifty yuan today, he would never be able to see Xu Xidi in his life.Seeing his dark face, Wang Xiuju didn't dare to say more words of rejection, so she had to put down the bowl and go to the house to get the money.He handed the money to Liu Yuning, but he still felt a little pain in his heart, so he couldn't help but murmured."You said borrow it, when will you pay it back? Can you afford it? What can I pay back?" "I told you, I'll pay you back as soon as you get paid at work." Liu Yuning took the money, turned around and walked out the door."I'm not talking about you!" Xu Xidi stood outside the door, and his words could be heard in the main room.In order to reassure Wang Xiuju, she said at the top of her voice, "Aunt, I raise pigs. If you are worried, I can write a note. I will keep it, so I won't be afraid of defaulting on the bill." Wang Xiuju curled her lips."Tip? You know a few words, so just write a note..." "Write any note, you don't have to write it. Just keep it in your mind." Liu Yuning handed the money to Xu Xidi."It's better to write a note. When the money is paid off, tear it up and have proof." Although Xu Xidi has never read a book, she still understands these basic principles.Wang Xiuju didn't want to borrow money because she was afraid that she would default on the loan.Write a note, it’s for Wang Xiuju."It's really unnecessary." Liu Yuning didn't think fifty yuan was much money to him.Not to mention fifty, as long as she wants it, five hundred, five thousand, he will earn it for her in the future."Yes, we must." Xu Xidi insisted."Son, if she insists on writing, it would be wrong of us to refuse. Let her write." Wang Xiuju was not polite at all. She turned around and went to Liu Yuning's room to take out paper and pen.Liu Yuning stared helplessly at his old mother, but she pretended she couldn't see it and took it out and stuffed it into Xu Xidi's hand.Xu Xidi picked up the ballpoint pen, pressed out the pen tip, then squatted down, spread out the homework book, and placed it on his knees.But after thinking for a long time, he didn't even start writing. He raised his head and asked blankly, "Brother, how should I write the note?" "I'm illiterate, and I still pretend to be a cultural person..." Wang Xiuju snorted, folding her hands and watching the fun.Liu Yuning helped the person up, took the paper and pen, "I'll write it, you just need to sign it. Can you write your name? If not, you can just put a check mark below." "Can this still happen? Can you just check it?" Xu Xidi was eye-opening. This was the first time he heard about it."Well, people who can't write are like this." Liu Yuning nodded, and then wrote a line of words."Here, you put a check mark underneath." "Okay." Xu Xidi took the pen and paper, carefully and solemnly put a check mark under the position designated by Liu Yuning.But after finishing the stroke, she looked at it again and again, and asked doubtfully, "Brother, in this line of words, which one is the five character? Which one is the cross? I dare not say the other characters. I know the five characters and the cross." "Uh~" Liu Yuning's ears instantly became hot.After feeling the heat, he quickly pointed to two of the words seriously, "These are the two words, fifty, that's how it's written on regular notes." Xu Xidi felt relieved, "So it's written like this on the note, fifty." She took a look at it and silently remembered it in her heart.When Xu Xidi took the money and left, Liu Yuning quickly tore off the 'IOU'.I saw a line above that read: Liu Yuning likes Xu Xidi, please approve.The following is what Xu Xidi ticked.
